qualification_candidate.rule: These exact blobs are the first Q0 qualification candidate. A failure may not be repaired in place or hidden by changing an oracle. Any implementation correction requires a numbered amendment and new candidate blob identities while preserving the failed hosted run.

f0_certificate_replay.requirement: Run the unchanged frozen 62-oracle F0 gate first. Then route an actual C3 refinement-certificate object through W10 and W11 for every frozen oracle.
f0_certificate_replay.accept_rule: For each F0 ACCEPT oracle, build the exact oracle source, independently derive the exact program/artifact and fresh candidate certificate, and require W10 and W11 ACCEPT with identical C3 certificate_id and C2 certificate_id.
f0_certificate_replay.reject_rule: For every non-ACCEPT F0 oracle, submit a syntactically valid candidate certificate object through both W10 and W11. Parse/semantic-invalid sources use a valid control certificate against the exact invalid source. Cross-check oracles use the frozen attack meaning (stale/forged trace, source, target, program, artifact, boundary, gas, REALIZE, or checker disagreement) and both certificate checkers must fail closed.
f0_certificate_replay.anti_gaming: The original F0 oracle must still pass at its frozen intended plane. Certificate-layer rejection alone cannot substitute for the original 62-oracle result.

g1_certificate_subset.rationale: Every original G1 seed is represented. Structured indices plus the forced-meta base cover all five frozen graph families; all four metamorphic relations, two high-complexity stress profiles, and each of the twelve negative mutation families are exercised per seed.
g1_certificate_subset.positive_rule: Every selected valid or metamorphic/stress profile must produce a real candidate certificate accepted independently by W10 and W11 with identical commitments.
g1_certificate_subset.negative_rule: Every selected negative mutation retains its accepted base as a support control. The negative object is then passed through the certificate lane and must fail closed at the corresponding profile/downstream/certificate plane.

r0_certificate_reference_subset.selection_rule: For each update index u=0..7 and predicate index p=0..5 choose initial=(u+p)%3, prefix=(u XOR p)%2, true_trace=(2*u+p)%8, false_trace=(u+3*p+1)%8 under the frozen R0 enumeration; this yields 48 descriptors fixed below.
r0_certificate_reference_subset.ordinary_rule: For every selected descriptor, regenerate the full pinned W9 JSONL reference and verify its aggregate digest first; compile the descriptor, require W9 ordered trace equality, generate a real C3 refinement certificate, and require W10/W11 acceptance and identical commitments.
r0_certificate_reference_subset.veto_rule: Each deliberately mistranslated compiler output must remain internally certificate-valid for its actual mutated C3 source (W10/W11 ACCEPT its freshly generated certificate) while the independently frozen W9 descriptor semantics veto the mismatch. Certificate acceptance must never override the W9 reference veto.

certificate_generative_mutation.valid_base_pool: Deterministic accepted certificate pool drawn from F0 ACCEPT, selected G1 positive profiles, and selected R0 ordinary descriptors; exact pool digest is emitted before mutations.
negative_families: c3_source_id bit mutation with stale outer id
c3_source_id bit mutation with recomputed outer id
c3_semantic_id mutation with recomputed outer id
reachable_graph_id mutation with recomputed outer id
ordered_trace_map_id mutation with recomputed outer id
c2_program_sha256 mutation with recomputed outer id
c2_artifact_id mutation with recomputed outer id
c2_target_id mutation with recomputed outer id
c2_certificate_id mutation with recomputed outer id

projected_REALIZE add one canonical but false pair then recompute outer id
claim_id substitution then recompute outer id

certificate_generative_mutation.positive_semantics: All positive representation mutations preserve the semantic candidate object. Because projected_REALIZE is frozen as a mathematical set in the C0 certificate transcript, pair-order permutation must preserve certificate_id and acceptance.
certificate_generative_mutation.negative_rule: Every negative trial must be rejected by both exact candidate checkers even when the attacker recomputes the outer C3 certificate_id wherever specified.
certificate_generative_mutation.positive_rule: Every positive trial must be accepted by both exact candidate checkers with the same certificate_id as its unmutated base.
certificate_generative_mutation.disagreement_rule: Any W10/W11 disagreement, crash, malformed output, or skipped trial fails Q0.

qualification_success_rule: W10/W11 exact candidate blob pins pass without source mutation.
Unchanged frozen F0 gate remains 62/62 and all 62 certificate-object replays satisfy their qualification oracle.
All 208 selected G1 scenarios plus 104 support controls satisfy the frozen certificate replay rules.

Pinned W9 reference root is regenerated exactly; all 48 ordinary R0 descriptor certificates pass and all four common-mode mutated compiler outputs are certificate-valid for their actual source but vetoed by W9.
All 1024 negative certificate mutations reject in both checkers and all 256 positive representation mutations accept in both with invariant certificate_id.
Qualified C2, K1 semantics, frozen W7/W8/W5/W6, F0/G1/R0 science artifacts remain untouched.
No qualification status is claimed until a later science/qualification anchor records a fully green hosted run.
